# Preset CLI

Skills that teach agents to work with Preset CLI. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [preset-io/agent-skills](https://github.com/preset-io/agent-skills), at commit `838f0a4`.

Preset CLI skills for explicit shell, scripting, and CI/CD workflows driven by the `sup` CLI (PyPI package `superset-sup`).

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Preset CLI**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Preset CLI**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install preset-cli-skills@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

2 skills: `preset-cli`, `preset-cli-mutations`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/preset-io/agent-skills
